Elite Spine Centres was founded by Dr. Michael Bryant (Chiropractic, USA), who entered the world of chiropractic with a different perspective and background than most other chiropractors in practice today

At Elite Spine Centres, one of our goals is to educate the public about issues which they are generally unaware, as there are so many people out there suffering from a range of problems which could be impacted by poor spine and nervous system function.

Over 80% of Singaporeans will experience Neck Pain or Back Pain in their lifetime. Delaying proper treatment can result in scar tissue, loss of mobility and permanent damage in some cases. Contact us to discover and correct the root causes of your problems and avoid long-term injury.
